normalization_policy: normalized claim plus artifact and evidence target; no voting

findings.claim: A candidate-equal restart may finalize an APPLIED transition from candidate equality and strict validation alone, without durable proof that the edge-specific live authority/readiness checks and authorized guarded writer produced those bytes.
findings.evidence_excerpt: if bytes equal the candidate, it deterministically re-runs strict validation and create-once finalizes the identical APPLIED completion
findings.impact: A candidate written after authority or readiness drift, or by another natively capable writer, can be laundered into a complete transition lineage and then support later charge, dispatch, or acceptance decisions.
findings.recommended_action: Permit candidate-equal APPLIED finalization only when a preexisting immutable guarded-write receipt proves the exact writer, edge-specific boundary checks, authority state, source version, candidate hash, and write result; otherwise enter transition-recovery-blocked and do not create APPLIED.

findings.claim: The source-equal charge restart requires a new boundary receipt but reuses an immutable intent whose exact candidate bytes/hash were pinned before that new observation; the design defines no way to bind the new receipt into the unchanged candidate ledger bytes.
findings.evidence_excerpt: P7–P12 live capabilities/Goal/Team/reviewer/budget state and the new boundary receipt
findings.impact: The restart must either write a candidate bound to stale boundary evidence or alter the pinned candidate and break intent/hash identity, so the claimed fresh fail-closed charge boundary is not mechanically realizable.
findings.recommended_action: On every source-equal charge restart, close the old intent NOT_APPLIED and create a fresh candidate and intent that bind the new boundary receipt before any guarded write; otherwise specify and validate an exact representation that incorporates fresh receipt bytes without changing the pinned candidate hash.

findings.claim: The closed four-effect pre-charge write set contains no operation that can persist the fresh path-and-hash receipt artifacts required for live P7–P11 and P14 evidence before the AdmissionBundle is sealed, while prepare is explicitly read-only.
findings.evidence_excerpt: the only pre-charge writes are four coordinator-owned, uncharged control/evidence effects separately approved under P15
findings.impact: A conforming implementation cannot produce a valid READY bundle from fresh evidence; an implementation that writes those receipts anyway uses undeclared effects, while reuse of old paths permits stale or replayed readiness evidence.
findings.recommended_action: Either embed every fresh canonical receipt and its raw evidence inside the bytes written by the approved bundle seal, or add one explicit create-once evidence-pack operation with owner, schema, paths, bounded effects, accounting, validation, and crash recovery, then include it in P15 and the pre-charge write invariant.
